messages.subject: [IT] Document management system maintenance - Saturday 14 March
messages.plaintextBody:
Colleagues,

The DMS will be unavailable from 20:00 to 23:00 on Saturday 14 March for scheduled maintenance and indexing upgrades. Please save and close all documents before then. Email is unaffected.

IT Helpdesk
Whitfield Carter LLP
